_meta.com.requstory/summary: Can AI agents read and use a website? Up to 3 pages.

description: Check whether AI agents can read, understand and act on any website (bots allowed, readable pages, product data, checkout, help). Reads up to 3 public pages; results are kept for 24 hours and public at requstory.com/ai-readiness/<domain>/. Faster and narrower than map_website. If status is "queued" or "running", call again with start=false.

start.description: Start a new check if none is fresh (default true). Use false to only read the result.

website.description: Website address or domain, e.g. "posthog.com" or "https://www.example.co.uk".

name: check_ai_readiness
title: Check AI-agent readiness
